================================================================================
INSTRUCTIONS
================================================================================

1. Create a new GitHub repository (e.g., "plausible-k8s")

2. Go to: Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions

3. Click "New repository secret" for each secret above

4. Copy and paste the exact values (be careful with whitespace)

5. Push this plausible-k8s directory to your GitHub repository:
   cd plausible-k8s
   git init
   git add .
   git commit -m "Initial Plausible deployment setup"
   git remote add origin git@github.com:YOUR_USERNAME/plausible-k8s.git
   git push -u origin main

6. The deployment will automatically start!

7. Monitor deployment: Actions tab in GitHub

8. After deployment completes, visit: https://plausible.jankylabs.co.uk


================================================================================
IMPORTANT NOTES
================================================================================

- Keep this file SECURE and do NOT commit it to git
- The .gitignore is configured to exclude *.txt files
- All secrets are randomly generated and unique to your deployment
- KUBE_CONFIG is base64-encoded and ready to use
- If you regenerate secrets later, you'll need to update the GitHub secrets
  and redeploy
